title: Umar Khalid : From the Eyes of His Loved Ones
original_title: Umar Khalid : From the Eyes of His Loved Ones
overview: Umar Khalid, who once dreamed of playing cricket for India, now faces serious terrorism charges from the government. The vilification spurred by media trials reached its peak with a chilling assassination attempt. He's been in prison for 3.5 years as of March 2024, highlighting a worrying crackdown on dissent in India. This is his story, as told by his loved ones.
